fact_text: A limit order sets the price at which a buy or sell should execute, and it waits in the queue until the market reaches that level.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '14. Understanding Types of Orders in Technical Analysis | Market Order Limit Order & Stop-Loss Order' (YouTube, 2024-11-01)

fact_text: A stop-loss order activates only when price crosses a set trigger level, used either to exit a holding on a fall or to buy once price breaks above a resistance level.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '14. Understanding Types of Orders in Technical Analysis | Market Order Limit Order & Stop-Loss Order' (YouTube, 2024-11-01)
